items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: So I did work with him. That's who I was working with when I got the call to go in the post office. I was working with Fess.

ctx.x: because the others had to close up and go on and all like that. He liked me and I liked him, too. He was a trumpet player, a good trumpet player, too.

So I did work with him. That's who I was working with when I got the call to go in the post office. I was working with Fess. Fess had an average of about three or four jobs a week. And it was remarkable at that time, because nobody was working in music. Things were closed up in town. Oh, it was a terrible time.
When was the last time you made a record? Or appeared on a record?
